# AffineDrift

> Public technical site on control-affine golf mechanics, companion to UpstreamDrift simulation software.

AffineDrift teaches drift/control decomposition, publishes textbooks and research notes, and links to version-pinned UpstreamDrift catalogs. It does not present every interpretation as settled.

## Essential Pages

- [Start Here](https://affinedrift.com/pages/start-here.html): Reading paths and evidence labels
- [Overview](https://affinedrift.com/pages/overview.html): Scope and UpstreamDrift snapshot
- [UpstreamDrift Getting Started](https://affinedrift.com/pages/upstreamdrift-getting-started.html): Install from upstream README (submodule, verify, launch)
- [UpstreamDrift Headless and Agents](https://affinedrift.com/pages/upstreamdrift-headless-and-agents.html): ud-sim, ud-sim-mcp, REST simulate route
- [Mathematical Notation](https://affinedrift.com/pages/notation.html): ZTCF, ZVCF, drift, control
- [Programming Companion](https://affinedrift.com/models/programming/index.html): Pinned UpstreamDrift program catalog
- [How to Read This Site](https://affinedrift.com/pages/how-to-read.html): Publication states and evidence ladder

## UpstreamDrift (External)

- Repository: https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift
- Headless schema: https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/main/schemas/sim-run-v1.json
- MCP adapter doc: https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/main/docs/development/sim_run_mcp.md
